name: Browser Authentication Page
description: Collects an installation-scoped Personal Access Token and establishes the signed Browser session before the remote workbench starts.

states: Inspect the signed-out Personal Access Token form, trusted-network warning, invalid-token recovery, and both shipped locales.

useWhen: A Browser document was redirected from an unauthenticated remote-workbench route.
A user must exchange a Desktop-created Personal Access Token for a Browser session Cookie.
avoidWhen: The renderer is running inside the trusted Desktop window and receives its authority from Main.
An authenticated Browser session has already reached the requested product route.
invariants: The Personal Access Token is submitted only to the same-origin session endpoint and is never persisted in Browser storage.
Successful sign-in resumes only one validated same-origin relative return target.
All errors remain bounded and localized, and the trusted-network HTTP limitation stays visible.
